title: Amazingly VulkanMod-Focused
description: modpack that uses vulkanmod and has a bunch of other mods with it too
body:
## description  
pretty cool modpack i made that is focused around vulkanmod and has mods that are hopefully compatible with vulkan mod. this modpack has mods focused on performance that like i said hopefully is compatible with vulkan mod. btw, not that many mods tbh. also, **it supports fabric only.**  

btw the lists to the mods are here in this collection below ⬇️  
https://modrinth.com/collection/ry3q9hnt  

anyways i made this modpack myself, so yeah. i dont need funding or anything, it's pretty easy (i dont create modpacks just so i can get money, i do it because it's easy, i dunno how to code, and i love doing it).  

oh btw, i am the same guy that is maintaining [splitted mp](https://modrinth.com/project/o28n84zq).

# ⚠️ WARNING 🚨  
**OLDER HARDWARE WON'T SUPPORT VULKAN!**  
ANY HARDWARE THAT'S NOT GEFORCE GTX 600 and above (Nvidia) or RADEON HD 7000 SERIES (intergrated) and above or RX 200/300 SERIES (desktop) (i ignored intel)
